baseline.scope: Owned responses in headless Edge; both bundles and both observer wrapping orders. No personal browser profile or real video download.

scope.final: 72 metadata cases; 48 pending capture; 32 JSON readers; 52 streaming readers; nine Node regression runs
scope.addedControls: Eight format-cap/lifecycle cases added after the baseline
scope.engine: Owned headless Edge profiles for Chromium and Firefox bundle sources, in both observer wrapping orders; not the Firefox engine
scope.limitations: API ownership protects its acceptance snapshot; getter-only additions lack independent network provenance. New-visit getter freshness and legitimate old-object mutations remain unresolved. No zeroization, total browser memory or real-time deadline claim.
